June 24, 1929.

REPORT ON Mr. Graham Torrie.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by Jhn Robertson C.D.I.

With reference to the official, Mr. Graham Torrie
who visited this office on June 11, 1929, it was evident from his behaviour it
was evident that he was out to know what information we possessed
rather than to assist us in any way. He denied that he is in
any way indebted to Mr. H. V. E. Michens and on the contrary
contended that it was the other way about. As he was not enlight-
ened to any extent as to the contents of Mr. Michens' letter of
5.3.29 he returned to this office on June 22 with the Power of
Attorney, mentioned in the letter referred to, which gives Mr.
Graham Torrie power to act in China for Mr. Michens and also
gives him power of attorney over the latters property in British
Columbia and elsewhere in Northern Canada. The document however
is of no value as it does not bear Mr. Michens signature and Mr.
Graham Gorrie refuses to part with it. In his conversation
about Mr. Michens Mr. Graham Gorrie states that he met the former
some time ago in British Columbia and after working for him for
one year entered into partnership with him for a few months but
withdrew from the firm owing to Michens somewhat erratic and
suspicious disposition. From the above and the contents of
Mr. Michens' letter it will be seen that it is impossible to get
the correct details of the case outside of Vancouver and in any
case the matter appears to be one for civil action.

Mr. Graham Gorrie was born of British parents in
B. C. Canada in August 1903 and registered at the local British
Consulate as a clerk, on April 4, 1929. He arrived in China in
1924 to join the staff of the Kaiping Mining Administration.

关于 Graham Torrie 先生的报告。

由 D. I. Robertson 制作。经 Jhn Robertson C.D.I. 转呈。

关于于1929年6月11日访问本局的官员 Graham Torrie 先生，从其行为举止可以明显看出，他意在探知我们要掌握何种信息，而非以任何方式协助我们。他否认欠 H. V. E. Michens 先生任何债务，相反声称是对方欠他债。由于他对 Michens 先生1929年3月5日来信的内容并未完全知情，他于6月22日携带信中提及的授权委托书返回本局，该委托书授予 Graham Torrie 先生代表 Michens 先生在中国行事的权力，并授予其对后者位于不列颠哥伦比亚及加拿大北部其他地区财产的代理权。然而，该文件因无 Michens 先生签名而毫无价值，且 Graham Gorrie 先生拒绝交出该文件。在谈及 Michens 先生时，Graham Gorrie 先生称，他不久前在不列颠哥伦比亚结识了前者，为其工作一年后与其合伙数月，但因 Michens 性情反复无常且多疑而退出公司。综上所述及结合 Michens 先生信件内容可见，除温哥华外，无法获取本案的确切细节，且无论如何，此事似乎属于民事诉讼范畴。

Graham Gorrie 先生于1903年8月出生于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省，父母均为英国人，并于1929年4月4日在当地英国领事馆注册为职员。他于1924年来华，加入开平矿务局任职。

Dionisio Trombetta employed until 1928 with C. L. G... Co.
returned to Italy in Jan. 1929. He returned to Shanghai in
January 1930 and after being unemployed for some time he obtained
a position in April with Joseph Pistorius as a Salesman Travelling
Food stuff Inspector. He resides in lodgings kept by
Mrs. Jewell at 10 Quinsan Gardens.

I suggest that a letter giving his address be sent
to Mr. E. W. T. Tichner in continuation of letter, I. S. D.
No. 142 of April 24, 1930.

Dionisio Trombetta 受雇于 C. L. G... Co. 直至1928年，于1929年1月返回意大利。他于1930年1月回到上海，失业一段时间后，于4月在 Joseph Pistorius 处获得一份食品推销员兼检查员的职位。他居住在昆山路花园 10 号 Jewell 太太经营的寓所内。

我建议致信 E. W. T. Tichner 先生，告知其地址，以延续1930年4月24日发出的 I. S. D. 第142号信件。

April 24, 29

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter of March 8,
addressed to the Commissioner of Police, careful
enquiries have been made, but no trace has so far
been found of the present whereabouts of Ronald
Cruhan Corrie who is reported to have left Shanghai
for Chinwangtao in North China.

The inquiries about this individual are
being continued and any fresh information obtained
regarding his address will be communicated to you.

Yours faithfully,

Acting Director of Criminal Investigation.

E. W. T. Hichens, Esq.,
c/o Lan Cameron & Co.,
Barristers,
522 Pender Street West,
Vancouver B. C.

先生：关于 Robert Ronald Graham 先生一事

关于我的合伙人 A. G. BEANIE，他于去年一月前往上海，现在看来，他既无返回之意，甚至从未有过此打算，我不愿讨论他那许多愚蠢的行径，因为它们似乎永无止境，但他让我非常非常失望，并使自身陷入如此境地，以致其不诚实之举现已为人所知。但从我的角度来看，最严重的外部财务问题是，他代表我持有

pages.en:
behalf a full power of attorney ; which I
wish to regain .
If he wishes to leave well then I am glad it
has happened now as later he might have let
me down much worse , but my feelings are not
vindictive , what is the use to bring him back
would cost $2000 odd & nothing gained , at the
same time I cannot risk him playing the fool
any more :
I also founded & conduct here a purely
commercial & criminal investigation service , it is
possible that he has a filled in identity card & also
a blank one ( or more ) these must be destroyed . My three
solid years of work building a reputation cannot
be risked . I have talked the whole thing over with
the Mounties & City Police , from whom inquiries etc.
as to myself may be made . Having chased &
more confidence men etc out of B.C during the
last two years than anyone else , it is rather
humorous that I should have this experience
pages.zh:
一份完整的授权委托书；我希望收回该委托书。
如果他愿意好聚好散，那么我很高兴事情现在就发生，因为日后他可能会让我遭受更严重的损失，但我并无报复之心，把他带回来有何用处？这将花费2000余美元且一无所获，同时我也不能冒险让他继续胡闹：
我在此还创立并经营着一家纯商业及刑事调查服务机构，他可能持有一张填好的身份卡，还有一张或多张空白卡，这些必须销毁。我三年来建立声誉的扎实工作不能冒此风险。我已就整件事与骑警队及市警察局进行过商讨，他们可证实对我的查询等事宜。在过去两年里，我从不列颠哥伦比亚省驱逐的骗子等人比任何人都多，因此我有此经历颇为讽刺

pages.en:
mother, who is distraught with anxiety.
Please excuse me writing personally but
the whole situation is so utterly damn silly
that I felt an official communication would
fail to clear the air & have to be dealt with
officially. Lorrie speaks Chinese & Russian
was formerly with K.L.M.A, Tientsin etc. He
called for letters on Jan. 27: at C.P.R Agent
(a further letter leave addressed to him there by this mail)
Shanghai. 6 ft. 1; rounded shoulders, clean
shaven when he left but usually wears large
shaggy moustache: Age 26: Vivid imagination
but morose disposition: Actually he is in
possession of goods of the firm but never mind
that, but he should send me a clear statement
also of his personal debts & what he proposes
to do about them: Also ask him about $500
obtained the day he left: Any further information
will be given on request. Until I hear from you
am taking no other action. Yrs faithfully
Eric. H. T. Fisher
Late, R.I.C. A.D
pages.zh:
母亲，她正焦虑万分。
请原谅我亲自致信，但整个局势实在愚蠢透顶，我觉得官方公文无法澄清局面，必须私下处理。Lorrie 会说中文和俄语，此前曾在天津开平矿务局等处任职。他于1月27日在上海加拿大太平洋铁路公司代理处领取信件（另有一封信留交给他，已通过本次邮件寄往该处）。身高6英尺1英寸；溜肩，离开时面部光洁，但通常留有浓密蓬乱的大胡子：年龄26岁：想象力丰富但性格阴郁：实际上他占有公司的货物，但这暂且不论，但他应向我发送一份清晰的声明，说明其个人债务及打算如何处理：另外询问他关于离境当日获得的500美元一事：如有进一步信息需求，请告知。在收到您的回复之前，我不采取其他行动。此致

Sir,
    Despite careful enquiries no trace of A. T. Gorrie's
whereabouts in Shanghai can so far be found. Gorrie
arrived in Shanghai about the beginning of January of
this year and left on the 19th of the same month for
Tsingwntao with the expectation of finding employment
with the T. T. there. It is believed that he was
unsuccessful in his quest and had returned to Shanghai.
    Enquiries are being kept up with a view to locating
this person and should he be found a report will at once
be submitted.

J.R.
